headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 4, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels fell to the Baltimore Orioles 1-3, while the New York Mets secured a 6-2 victory over the Cleveland Guardians. The Cincinnati Reds edged the Athletics 5-4, and the Washington Nationals were shut out by the Philadelphia Phillies 5-0.

Injuries continue to plague several teams, with the Washington Nationals' James Wood being placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. The Athletics have also suffered injuries, with Jeffrey Springs and Nick Kurtz being placed on the 15-day and 10-day injured lists, respectively.

Several trades have taken place, including the Athletics acquiring RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for RF Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee, while the Colorado Rockies traded RHP Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for 1B Connor Norby and RHP Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Angels Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels dropped a 1-3 decision to the Baltimore Orioles in their latest matchup. Tyler O'Neill led the Orioles' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Cade Povich earned the win with 6 strong innings of work.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Guardians 6-2**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 6-2 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Sean Manaea earning the win after 6.0 innings pitched. Luis Torrens led the Mets' offense with a 3-hit, 4-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Reds Edge Athletics in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 5-4 victory over the Athletics, with Julian Garcia earning the win. Brady Singer led the Athletics' pitching effort, throwing 6.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 3 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall to Phillies in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals were defeated 5-0 by the Philadelphia Phillies, marking a tough outing for the team. Jesús Luzardo led the Phillies to victory with an impressive 8.0 innings pitched, striking out 7 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Nationals' James Wood Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Washington Nationals right fielder James Wood has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain.

top_news.title: **Athletics Acquire RHP Seth Johnson in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Seth Johnson to the Athletics on August 3, 2026, in exchange for RF Colby Thomas.
